preconditions: an attacker who can feed onnxruntime a crafted .onnx model (or a tensor) — local model processing, or an inference service running attacker-supplied models

the model declares the optional position_ids input (EmbedLayerNormalization input 8) with rank 1; onnxruntime's shape inference validates input_ids rank but does NOT validate position_ids rank, so the malformed model loads
